items.description: The SEO Audit tool from SEO Review Tools, utilizes the power of Ahrefs, SEMrush and MOZ to present you with a full website SEO audit in just 15 seconds. Data returned by this tool include: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Search volume and Backlink count. After entering your URL, this tool will analyse your website based on 21 different data points.

The Backlink Checker gives you access to the backlink profile of your website and that of your competitors. When you submit an URL you can choose to view the complete backlink profile for a website or you can select to view the backlinks pointing at a specific webpage. Other metrics returned by the backlink checker include: Ahrefs Domain rating, Anchor text, Referring Domains and Referring IPs.
QuickBlox MapChat is a simple plugin for WordPress, that adds a MapChat (chat integrated with map) widget to your website. You can chat over a map or in chat room.
A place for auto enthusiasts to show off their rides. Check out cars and motorcycles from around the world.
App building options is a list of 6 common options for building apps on mydigitalstructure.

InDash allows you to manage and process your incoming text messages. It lets you quickly setup a dashboard for your Nexmo incoming numbers. You can configure SMS forwards to email / URLs or setup keyword-based auto-responders.
Simply text #selection to see it appearing on the web page in real time!
Find useful information about Singapore places
FYIfly leverages the Active.com API to show different active events based on location.
Site developed to share walking and running routes.
Map-based price and fuel quality reporting community covering Brazil. Try searching for Rio de Janeiro
Get the latest Stock Quotes on Google Maps.
Features information on the Southern Highlands of NSW, Australia. Google Map mashups are included with each town profile, and business listed on the site.

A mash up of a broadband checker, Google Maps and Yahoo AJAX. Maps the distance to your exchange and calculates the speed of an ADSL connection as shows a list of broadband providers in the area. NOTE: Jan 07 appears down.
Easy way to listen music.
Create personalized T-Shirts with your own coded messages.
See George W's life history plotted on this Google Map.
New year's greetings using the Flickr API.
A straightforward and clean interface to YouTube via their APIs. Workplace safe.
A meta search engine with images, videos and news. Enabled by social search.
1dollarthings.com combines your favorite online stores into one big dollar store bargain hunt. It stores APIs to find items under a certain price point.

Voicendo provides a user interface for small businesses and independent professionals to manage their incoming phone calls (even SMS) routed according to their call rules, routes and variables, anywhere and however they like. Supports toll-free and local numbers. Port existing numbers for $5 a month.
A real-time list of the most recent tweets and Flickr photos concerning beds and bedrooms. More feeds to come.
Like tinyurl, but for maps. Create a map, add routes or points of interest, and get a short URL to share it or come back to it later.
TodoToday Pro for Teambox is a task list application to show current todo items from the online collaboration and project management tool Teambox

Time tracking, inventory and resource management from your phone. Time Keeper and Inventory Tracker updates by SMS or web. Barcode generator; scan and text to update. Project Management integration. SMS requires a Twilio account.
Get notified by SMS when someone fills in your Wordpress online contact form. Also works with Contact Form 7.
See dozens of current terror threats or incidents around the world. Includes airport, chemical, bridge, railway, bomb and other incidents. With links to related news stories and searchable database.
A full social network with information and photos about the great rock climbing areas in Mexico.
User driven search where users contribute listings, reviews, pictures, tags, and more. Toronto is first city setup, includes mapped traffic conditions.

Daily Crypto lets you add crypto tokens to easily track their prices, price change & 24h highs and lows in your new browser tab! Tired of clicking through multiple sites, watchlists and more to track your crypto token prices? Daily Crypto replaces your default tab, and lets you easily access latest token prices of your curated selection of crypto tokens. From latest token prices, to price %age changes, 24 hour highs, lows and market cap ranks - we keep you updated.

This unique road trip planner locates hundreds of points of interest along the trail pioneered by the Lewis and Clark Expedition. Find historic sites, national parks, state parks, campgrounds and much more. Great way to plan a family vacation!
A new developing comparison shopping mashup using Shopping.com API.

TrivAsia is an online booking company that supplies information on different destinations in Asia. The TrivAsia services include booking flights, finding travel packages, searching for hotels, and more.

Asiya Travels Online offer a wide variety of online booking for domestic and international airlines, bus, rail, car, hotel packages, Esselworld and more. The Asiya Travels Online directory is an effort to bring the major ticketing agencies of India under one roof as to help the online user in making the best choice from a wide array of options.
Dutch National Heritage List in the Netherlands (rijksmonumenten). Many Dutch tourist attractions are rijksmonuments, such as castles or windmills. There are 61.000 rijksmonuments in the Netherlands.
Webcams around the world with Google Maps.
This mashup is the fastest way of creating memes via MMS.

Oishii is kind of a del.icio.us mini-zeitgeist. oishii: ephemeral pheromonal del.icio.us-ness. It polls the del.icio.us front page every 5 minutes, and returns all sites bookmarked by at least 30 people.

Gastro is a Google Maps mashup of the NSW Food Authority's name-and-shame lists. It collates the Register of Offences and the Register of Penalty Notices and displays the location of offending restaurants on a map. Source code available.

A Web-based reader for FriendFeed that displays your feed in the left frame. Web sites referenced in the feed are displayed on the right. See what your friends are linking to. AJAX interface auto-refreshes your feed. Implemented on Google App Engine.
Twitter cartoons. Each cartoon's text is populated by tweets on each subject. Browse through the selection of cartoons in the menu.
Allows Box.net users to preview documents in their Box accounts using iPaper by Scribd.
A musical mashup of Daft Punk songs. This mashup uses the SoundCloud API.
A national real estate search engine for rent to own homes. Choose your state and begin your search. Uses Oodle and Google Maps API's to power property listings.
The portfolio site of Ideum, an exhibit and Web design firm that specializes in multitouch and social media. Using WordPress and Flash.
Twitmart is a free classifieds marketplace using Twitter.

CampusBird is the first interactive 3D and Maps-based school search site. Search for schools by name, location, scene, weather, school size, and more. CampusBird provides in depth profiles of more than 4800 schools and hundreds in 3D. Formerly called Egiate.

iTavli by iSmart Solutions is a backgammon game mashup. The objective of each game is to transfer the chips (or checkers) from the base area to the collecting area. Each game has different rules that the players need to follow.
Map of Florida Kids Skipping School. See Attendance records for every school, zip code and school district.
Simple Amazon search interface that filters items to show only things eligible for Amazon Prime free shipping.
Simple apps to search a job for Indonesian.
An online social game that covertly teaches students how to do library research while they go about the business of completing a research-and-writing assignment.
Streeartmap supports buskers works and gives visitors the possibility to vote every single performance, like digg.
Users can Dub any YouTube video with the sound of the other video, classify them as funny, sad, action etc. View user videos and then share their creations with friends. More uses onsite.
Allows IT professionals to compare information about salary, job skills, and roles based on location. It also gives you an idea of demand based on the number of IT jobs advertised.
Mashup of members of the Live Butterfly members.
Allows Box.net users to share content directly from their Box accounts to their Facebook accounts.
OMG Rainbows predicts rainbows, by combining live radar data (for precipitation) and the altitude and azimuth of the sun.
Watch the data that you care about in this screensaver mashup of Facebook, Flickr, Twitter, and blogs. This visualization lets you configure what you want to watch and the speed in which you see it.
Using Amazon web services backend, Elasticlive allows to you to easily and instantly deploy an infinite number of servers using a convenient web based graphical interface.

Ask AMEE is an experiment that makes finding things easier. Instead of giving you a list of possible methodologies that might be relevant, it gives you an answer straight away. You can put in queries like â€œ10kg of coalâ€œ, and it will go off and see if AMEE has an answer. If it does, itâ€™ll give you it straight away, and give you links to find out more if you want to.
This is a Google Widget that shows festivals and events in the localities of in Kerala and Tamilnadu, India.
A useful worldwide travel guide in German and English. With embedded data from Wikipedia, Flickr and Google News. Double-click anywhere on the map for details on that location.

OSCity (Open Source City) brings the Dutch spatial planning together with the newest information technology. By directly searching, visualizing and combining spatial data everybody is invited - from citizen, entrepreneur, designer and civil servant - to gain insight into everything that is spatial.
Allows users to preview files in their Box.net accounts using Increo Preview.
Display weather radio stations on map.
The Social Local Web Scan Plugin for your website.

The Gifanator employs the Giphy API along with the Twilio API to allow people to receive or send randomly generated Gifs via text messaging. Users can also select keywords from a list of negative and positive emotions to send more specific Gifs to their friends.

Sgrouples Inc. features MeWe, a service dedicated to protect online privacy. In the site, users can immediately discover the number of cookies stalking from different social media providers. Some of the features include safe data, photo/video/chat options to interact with friends and family, privacy controls, and personal cloud. No Stalking, No Spying, and No Bullying are the MeWe principles that make this mashup unique.
Connected to Us creates a communication system using the hardware your team members and customers already own.

Information about schools and how you can help classrooms and students are displayed on a map. Choose from DonorsChoose (fundraising for classroom projects), Mentor Pro (volunteering) or Great Schools (school data).
A mobile phone app for finding real-time bus arrivals for Madison Metro (Madison, WI). Just text your specific request to receive real-time arrival estimates.
Quickoffice Connect is a mobile document editing suite, and its integration with Box.net allows users to load, edit, and save files in their Box accounts within Quickoffice.
Tracks micro-trends on twitter and brand user satisfaction. See metrics visualized using Google Visualization API.
Uses Google Maps & Places API to make viewing nearby search results easy.
